cases.scenario: Create a RebirthUO issue without an exact repository declared by applicable AGENTS.md.
cases.must_require: the exact repository identity from applicable AGENTS.md

cases.scenario: Create a new issue when no request or project instruction requires a template.
cases.must_preserve: the canonical fallback field order and template_optional_reason

cases.scenario: Create an issue with a live existing label whose relevance is directly supported by the issue scope.
cases.must_verify: the label exists, its source and rationale are recorded, and create read-back contains it

cases.scenario: Create an issue whose selected label is absent from the verified repository.
cases.must_preserve: INTAKE_BLOCKED with no creation or label mutation

cases.scenario: Create an issue where a non-template label only sounds related but has no issue-specific rationale.
cases.must_preserve: an ambiguous_label blocker and no mutation

cases.scenario: Create a template-based intake issue after the selected template digest changes.
cases.must_verify: a fresh TEMPLATE_READY packet, duplicate checks, selected labels, and issue read-back

cases.scenario: Return an intake result for a draft, blocked, or created issue.
